text:
A metal reacts vigorously with cold water.
Which statement about the metal is correct?
A
It is above hydrogen in the reactivity series.
B
It is below magnesium in the reactivity series.
C
Its oxide can be reduced with carbon.
D
It does not react with dilute acids.

options.label: A
options.text: It is above hydrogen in the reactivity series.

options.label: B
options.text: It is below magnesium in the reactivity series.

options.label: C
options.text: Its oxide can be reduced with carbon.

options.label: D
options.text: It does not react with dilute acids.
